        w=len(g[0]); h=len(g)
        seps=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(h))]
        blocks=[]; start=0
        for c in seps+[w]:
            if c>start: blocks.append((start,c)); start=c+1
        colors=[];pats=[];counts=[]
        for s,e in blocks:
            vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(s,e) if g[r][c]!=0]
            colors.append(max(set(vals), key=vals.count))
            pats.append([[g[r][s+j] for j in range(e-s)] for r in range(h)])
            counts.append(sum(v!=0 for p in pats[-1] for v in p))
        out=[]
        for r in range(h):
            row=[]
            for j in range(4):
                cand=[bi for bi in range(len(blocks)) if pats[bi][r][j]!=0]
                if not cand: row.append(0); continue
                if rule=='mincount':
                    best=max(cand,key=lambda b:(-counts[b],b))
                row.append(colors[best])
            out.append(row)
        return out
    return transform
